decision: Accepted: modest repeatable whole-model decode gains, 23 fewer submissions, exact outputs/state and preserved tracing. Hardware-limit objective remains incomplete.
design: Fuse value recurrence and BF16 output projection/residual on layers 1–23. Seven prepare/update/finish lanes, two copy bridges and eight projection workers: 31 cores, five BO arguments.
Original FP32 WKV function and finishing arithmetic retained; grouped head outputs feed BF16 GEMV. Write projection/residual into auxiliary vectors 25/26 and rebind FFN input.
Default BF16 and INT8 FFN-only decode: 123 to 100 submissions. INT8 FFN+output retains 123; paired prefill body unchanged.

Keep original runs for node/projection tracing; ordinary runs share BOs and unchanged prepared runs. Both plans use identical request-state buffers. Stats and odd-tail counters follow the active plan.

stage.validation: Bitwise state/projection/residual, untouched auxiliary vectors, independent FP64 projection oracle, reset/replay, immutable inputs and guards passed.

context_reuse.trigger: Adding the decode program initially failed batch2 graph construction at bf16-prefill-ffn-b2-recurrence-input with DRM_IOCTL_AMDXDNA_CREATE_HWCTX err=-22.
context_reuse.change: Recompile both FFN input layouts and compare complete device PDI bytes. Only if identical, copy the standard-layout xclbin into the strided-layout artifact while preserving its DMA instructions. Session shares hardware programs by device index/xclbin UUID/kernel, with independent instructions and weak cache entries.
context_reuse.validation: Both BF16 and INT8 FFN PDI pairs are byte-identical; corresponding xclbin pairs are byte-identical. Full-model alternating layouts, odd tails and decode handoff pass. No claim about the maximum supported context count.

whole_model_protocol.order: A/B/B/A per precision, hardware dispatch serial, profiling disabled, no compilation concurrent with timing

correctness.additional_checks: 128-step decode tests also switch from optimized execution back to full node trace and projection trace after state restoration, verify outputs/state and diagnostic counts, then restore the optimized plan.

limits: Isolated hot-stage gain is much larger than whole-model gain; neither proves program-switch cost or cache/memory bandwidth.
Resident byte/root-BO metrics count model data, not all XRT program/instruction memory.
INT8 output decode is not fused.
Whole-model XDNA hardware limits remain unproven.
next_action: Measure sensitivity to matrix working-set size and program alternation before attributing the dominant decode stage time to compute, DDR/DMA or context switching.
host_tests: Final release/test builds and 3/3 CTest passed. Promoted BF16/INT8 FFN-only batch2 CLI and BF16 sequential CLI dispatched successfully.

decode_profile.scope: Four instrumented sequential tokens from zero state, includes cold first token; host stage wall time, not device counters.
